programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: In mid-August 1944, the Allies launched 'Operation Anvil' to increase pressure on German troops after the Normandy landings. The 517th Airborne was tasked with preventing enemy tanks from reaching the beachhead. This episode recounts the story of three American sergeants and a British major who jumped into enemy territory, successfully completed their mission, and survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: Great Tank Battles
programme.desc: The fourth episode sees the Germans well and truly on the retreat and the Allies are able to successfully implement operation Husky - the landing on Sicily - where General Montgomery and the American General George Smith Patton ousted the Germans in little over five weeks. On the Eastern Front General Zhukov inflicted heavy defeat on the Germans now having the new T - 54 tank available.
